project.name: Keysy
project.descriptor: A mobile-first application to simplify the home-buying process with personalized recommendations and affordability insights.

guardrails.statement: The system must encrypt sensitive data in transit and protect user passwords.
The system must provide a disclaimer stating that affordability calculations are estimates and are not lending offers or financial advice.

stories.title: User Registration and Login
stories.narrative: As a new user, I want to create an account and log in, so that I can access the app's features.
acceptance_criteria: Given a new user, when they sign up using email, then they should be able to log in successfully.
Given a user, when they forget their password, then they should be able to reset it.
Trust: User credentials are securely stored and transmitted.

requirements.statement: The system must allow users to sign up using email, Google, or Apple.
The system must allow users to log in and log out securely.
